title: Bar Salts Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the exotic flavours of Kiwi, Passion Fruit, and Guava with Vampire Vape’s Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava. This e-liquid combines the tangy taste of kiwi, the vibrant tartness of passion fruit, and the juicy taste of guava to create a vibrant and refreshing tropical vaping experience. This flavour is part of the Vampire Vape Bar Salts range, which offers a 60VG/40PG mix in a generous 100ml shortfill format. The balance of VG and PG provides an optimal combination of throat hit and vapour production, making it especially suitable for MTL vaping devices designed for coils of 0.6ohm or higher. This setup ensures that vapers can enjoy a flavourful and satisfying mouth-to-lung experience. With each 100ml bottle of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s plenty of room to add nicotine shots, allowing for customization up to 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, depending on your preference. This versatility, combined with the long-lasting size, makes it an economical choice for daily vaping. Delve into the rest of the Vampire Vape Bar Salts collection to discover more intriguing flavours, each crafted to deliver the brand's signature intense taste and satisfaction.
